name: Doherty Threshold
axiom: When system response drops under four hundred milliseconds, people stay engaged and work faster.
trigger: A click blocks the interface for most of a second, and the person clicks again or looks away.
checklist: Update the interface at once on input, then reconcile with the server in the background.
Show skeletons that match the final layout when a wait exceeds four hundred milliseconds.
Prefetch likely next screens on hover or focus.

antiPattern.violation: A like button freezes for 750 ms while the request runs, with no visible change.
antiPattern.remediation: The icon fills immediately, the counter increments locally, and the request reconciles later.

academicOrigin.title: The Economic Value of Rapid Response Time
academicOrigin.publication: IBM Technical Report GE20-0752-0, White Plains, NY
